name: JOJO Limited
about: JOJO Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a vertically integrated entertainment company in India. The company offers products and services across various verticals, including OTT content through JOJO TV, live events via JOJO Experience, film and show production through JOJO Movies, and digital platforms, such as JOJO Nataks. JOJO Limited was formerly known as Madhuveer Com 18 Network Limited and changed its name to JOJO Limited in January 2026. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
